in_hebrew.name: נְתוֹרָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A symbol or signal used as a mark of authority, rank, or allegiance. In a military context, an ensign is a flag or standard.

in_greek.name: σημεῖον
in_greek.long_meaning: A visible or tangible representation of a concept, idea, or reality. In a religious context, a sign or token can be a symbol or an object that represents a spiritual truth or a covenant between God and His people.

in_latin.name: insignis
in_latin.long_meaning: A term used to denote something that sets someone or something apart as special or significant. In a heraldic context, an insignia is a symbol or emblem that represents an individual, family, or organization.
